svg.title: Trinity Peaks · Six-person suite — schematic exploration v1
svg.desc: Six residents in two doubles and two singles around a shared suite lounge, with two full bathrooms and two storage closets. Reaches six residents without any triple room. 6 beds. Envelope 44'-0" by 28'-0" (1232 sf) using exploratory dimensions. Not measured, not code reviewed, not for construction.
svg.text: Two doubles + two singles + suite lounge, no triples
6 beds · envelope 44'-0" × 28'-0" = 1,232 sf · 205.3 sf per bed
SCHEMATIC EXPLORATION · v1 · 2026-11-06 · Dimensions are exploratory assumptions (studies/assumptions.json), not measurements.
Not code-reviewed, not an accessibility determination, not for construction. Orientation not established (no north arrow).
Independent student design study by Ivan Minier, drawn with AI assistance. Not a UVM design or an adopted part of the Trinity Redistricting proposal.
